data.name: KanbanBoard_Desc
data.value: A Dataverse view as a drag-and-drop board, grouped by a choice column.

data.name: StatusField_Desc
data.value: The choice column that decides which lane a card is in. Its options become the lanes, and dragging a card writes the new option to this column. Must be a choice column, and must be in the view.

data.name: TitleField_Desc
data.value: The column shown as the card headline, and the name used when a move fails. Keep it short: a card is about 280 pixels wide.

data.name: AssigneeField_Desc
data.value: Optional. A text column shown in smaller text under the title, such as a contact or an owner name. Must be a text column — a lookup such as Owner cannot be bound here. Truncated with an ellipsis if it does not fit.

data.name: BadgeField_Desc
data.value: Optional. A short value shown as a chip on the card, such as a priority or a category. Any text is accepted, but a long value is truncated — this is a label, not a description.

data.name: Lanes_Desc
data.value: Optional. Left empty, the lanes are the Lane column’s own options, including ones no record is in yet. Set it — "1=New,2=Active,3=Resolved" — to fix the lanes and their order yourself. Required in canvas apps, where the options cannot be read. A lane can carry a colour as hex at the end of its label: “1=New #6b7280”.

data.name: LaneColors_Desc
data.value: Show each lane’s colour from the Lane column’s option set, as a bar above the lane. Turn it off where those colours were assigned automatically rather than chosen. Lanes with no colour — in canvas apps, or when the Lanes property is set — show no bar either way.

data.name: LaneWidth_Desc
data.value: Width of each lane in pixels.

data.name: OpenOnCardClick_Desc
data.value: Clicking a card opens its record. The move menu and drag handle stay available either way.

data.name: MovedRecordId_Desc
data.value: The ID of the card most recently moved to another lane.

data.name: PageSize_Desc
data.value: How many rows to request per page. The platform may clamp large values.

data.name: OpenedRecordId_Desc
data.value: The ID of the row most recently opened.

data.name: KanbanBoard_Error
data.value: This view could not be loaded.

data.name: KanbanBoard_NoStatus
data.value: Bind the Lane column to a choice column to group the cards.

data.name: KanbanBoard_NoTitle
data.value: Bind the Card title to a column to label the cards.

data.name: KanbanBoard_NoLanes
data.value: No lanes to show. Set the Lanes property to list them explicitly.

data.name: KanbanBoard_NoTargets
data.value: No other lanes to move to. Set the Lanes property to list every status, including ones no record is in yet.

data.name: KanbanBoard_MoveFailed
data.value: {0} could not be moved, and was put back.
